scope: Same-session documentary navigation checks against listed primary statement/verdict artifacts. Required-text tests are structural regression checks, not proof verification.

checks.answer: The q-parameter theorem improves the old schedule; fixed-constant N^2 log N yields at best a fixed inverse-power guarantee from this bound, not negligible error.

checks.answer: Finish the interrupted exact sparse review first, then test a full global expected-cost envelope for the exponential-genus connected decoder. checks.answer: Recorded acceptance covers N>=3, even m>=4, with exceptional cases explicit. It gives no polynomial gap. The m=2 multi-state chain has no allowed updates.

checks.answer: No. The exact connected algorithm has exponential genus cost. A bound on its global expected assembly cost or a stronger decoder is still needed, and the growing-genus eligibility obstruction remains scoped and valid.
